missions.title: The House on Kaguvi Hill
missions.premise: The archive and the ledger converge on a private estate north-east of Harare. Gumbo and Mavhunga are preparing to move the Shadow Protocol. What you brought with you determines how the night ends.
objectives: Choose what happens to the Shadow Protocol

beats.speaker: nyasha
beats.text: Kaguvi Hill. A colonial-era estate with a private road, a helipad, and a unit of Nightjar contractors. Somewhere inside, Gumbo and Mavhunga are preparing to move the Shadow Protocol. You have one night.

variants.text: Nyasha is not here. The Directorate took her from the Avondale safehouse three hours ago. Kaguvi Hill is still the target: a private estate, a helipad, and a unit of Nightjar contractors. Gumbo and Mavhunga are inside. So is she.
Tariro's story is everywhere. Nightjar is burning documents and moving people. Kaguvi Hill is still the centre of it. Gumbo and Mavhunga are inside, and they know you are coming.

choices.text: Tell me what I'm walking into.

beats.speaker: tendai
beats.text: Tendai is waiting in the back of the car with a hand-drawn map. 'The guards change at eleven,' he says. 'The east cameras go offline for ten minutes. I used to drive the supply truck.'

variants.text: Tendai is waiting in the back of the car with a hand-drawn map. 'The guards change at eleven,' he says. 'The east cameras go offline for ten minutes. I used to drive the supply truck.'
Tendai is waiting in the back of the car. He does not look at you. 'I'm only here because they killed my cousin,' he says. 'The guards change at eleven. That's all I know.'

Fingers is in the back seat, wrapped in a borrowed jacket. 'Mavhunga keeps the core file in the drawing room,' he says. 'He likes to look at it while he drinks. The safe is behind the portrait of the old governor.'

Mhofu meets you at the edge of the estate. He is out of uniform and looks older. 'I can open the east gate,' he says. 'But I am not killing anyone for you. And when this is over, I want my name out of it.'

beats.text: Three ways up the hill. The main gate is a killing box. The east service road is watched by cameras. Mukoma knows a hunter's path through the msasa trees. Tariro can attach you to a press convoy. And if Mhofu is still alive and willing, his keycard opens the service gate.
The house is quiet in the way a trap is quiet. Somewhere above you, a radio crackles and goes silent. You have one move before the night decides what kind of night it is.

choices.text: Move through the service corridors. No noise, no bodies.

success.text: You take the east stairwell two steps at a time. The cameras are off. The guards are where Tendai said they would be. The drawing room door is open.

failure.text: A guard turns the corner at the wrong moment. You take him down, but his radio is already live.

choices.text: Go through the front of the house. Make them react to you.

success.text: You take the guard post before they can close the door. The house wakes up angry, but you are already inside, and the drawing room is at the end of the hall.

failure.text: They are waiting for you. You make the hall, but you leave blood on the marble and a lot of noise behind you.

choices.text: Use Mhofu's keycard and walk in like you belong.
Find Nyasha first. She knows where the core file is.

beats.speaker: gumbo
beats.text: Farai Gumbo waits in the drawing room with a glass of whisky and a pistol he does not need. Collin Mavhunga stands by the window. Between them, on a table, is the Shadow Protocol: a folder, a drive, and a list of names that could break the country or save it.

choices.text: Tariro's story is already live. The only thing missing is your confession.
Fingers will testify. Mhofu will talk. The truth does not need your permission.
The Directorate gets the file. I get the names. Nobody else has to know.
I keep the protocol. Mukoma keeps the roads. We become the thing we were trying to stop.
None of us get it. Burn the house and everything in it.

beats.text: The room goes quiet. Outside, the first helicopter begins its descent.
Kaguvi Hill is behind you. The Shadow Protocol is no longer a secret. What happens next is a different season.
